// TestTeacherOnboardingHandoffExactStateFenceConcurrent proves the S8 fence in
// PostgreSQL rather than relying on an in-memory fake. Distinct goal commands
// for the same authoritative Student snapshot race through independent pool
// connections; exactly one durable intent wins.
func TestTeacherOnboardingHandoffExactStateFenceConcurrent(t *testing.T) {
	basePool := teacherDecisionIntegrationPool(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	schema := "teacher_s8_handoff_" + strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")
	quotedSchema := pgx.Identifier{schema}.Sanitize()
	_, err := basePool.Exec(ctx, "CREATE SCHEMA "+quotedSchema)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { _, _ = basePool.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP SCHEMA "+quotedSchema+" CASCADE") })

	conn, err := basePool.Acquire(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = conn.Exec(ctx, "SET search_path TO "+quotedSchema)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	root := migration019RepositoryRoot(t)
	upPaths, err := migration019UpPaths(root)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, path := range upPaths {
		sql, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
		require.NoError(t, readErr, path)
		_, execErr := conn.Exec(ctx, string(sql))
		require.NoError(t, execErr, path)
	}
	conn.Release()

	config := basePool.Config().Copy()
	if config.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams == nil {
		config.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams = map[string]string{}
	}
	config.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams["search_path"] = schema
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, config)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(pool.Close)

	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	studentID, teacherID, dialogID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO personal_teacher (
 id,student_id,teacher_profile_id,language,communication_style,pedagogy_profile,hint_policy,intervention_mode,created_at,updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,'default','ru','supportive','progressive','progressive','balanced',$3,$3)
`, teacherID, studentID, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	foundation := readyHandoffFixture(domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{
		Code: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherFoundationGraphVersion,
	})
	goBackend := readyHandoffFixture(domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{
		Code: domain.TeacherGoBackendGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherGoBackendGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherGoBackendGraphVersion,
	})
	teacher := domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: teacherID, StudentID: studentID}
	first, err := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(teacher, binding, foundation, "ru", "", "", now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second, err := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(teacher, binding, goBackend, "ru", "", "", now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second.ID, second.CommandID = uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	second.CommandTeacherJobID, second.NotificationCommandID = uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	request, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest(second)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second.RequestHash, err = domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestHash(second.StudentID, request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second, err = domain.NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(second)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	store := TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository{Pool: pool}
	start := make(chan struct{})
	errorsByCall := make(chan error, 2)
	var wait sync.WaitGroup
	for _, intent := range []domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{first, second} {
		intent := intent
		wait.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wait.Done()
			<-start
			_, _, enqueueErr := store.Enqueue(ctx, repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffEnqueue{Intent: intent}, now)
			errorsByCall <- enqueueErr
		}()
	}
	close(start)
	wait.Wait()
	close(errorsByCall)
	winners, conflicts := 0, 0
	for enqueueErr := range errorsByCall {
		switch {
		case enqueueErr == nil:
			winners++
		case errors.Is(enqueueErr, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict):
			conflicts++
		default:
			require.NoError(t, enqueueErr)
		}
	}
	require.Equal(t, 1, winners)
	require.Equal(t, 1, conflicts)
	var rows int
	require.NoError(t, pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID).Scan(&rows))
	require.Equal(t, 1, rows)
	var handoffID string
	require.NoError(t, pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT handoff_intent_id::text FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID).Scan(&handoffID))
	// Retries remain mutable while a command is still queued.
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=$2,updated_at=$2 WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1`, handoffID, now.Add(time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	claimToken := uuid.NewString()
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET status='dispatching',claim_token=$2,locked_by='integration-worker',locked_until=$3,updated_at=$4 WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1`, handoffID, claimToken, now.Add(2*time.Minute), now.Add(time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	plannerHandoffID := uuid.NewString()
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET status='accepted',claim_token=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,planner_handoff_id=$2,accepted_at=$3,readiness_observed_at=$3,updated_at=$3 WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1`, handoffID, plannerHandoffID, now.Add(2*time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET planner_handoff_id=$2 WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1`, handoffID, uuid.NewString())
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "Planner acknowledgement is immutable")
	claimToken = uuid.NewString()
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET status='message_pending',claim_token=$2,locked_by='integration-worker',locked_until=$3,updated_at=$4 WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1`, handoffID, claimToken, now.Add(3*time.Minute), now.Add(2*time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	notificationMessageID := uuid.NewString()
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET status='delivered',claim_token=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,notification_message_id=$2,delivered_at=$3,updated_at=$3 WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1`, handoffID, notificationMessageID, now.Add(3*time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET notification_message_id=$2 WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1`, handoffID, uuid.NewString())
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "Dialog delivery acknowledgement is immutable")
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET status='queued' WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1`, handoffID)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "status transition is invalid")
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET locale='en' WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "teacher onboarding handoff identity is immutable")
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "teacher onboarding handoff evidence cannot be deleted")
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `TRUNCATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff CASCADE`)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "teacher onboarding handoff evidence cannot be truncated")

	down, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db", "migrations", "021_teacher_onboarding_planner_handoff.down.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, string(down))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "immutable onboarding handoff evidence is retained permanently")
	var tableStillPresent bool
	require.NoError(t, pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff') IS NOT NULL`).Scan(&tableStillPresent))
	require.True(t, tableStillPresent)
}

func TestMigration021EmptyLedgerRollsBackAtomically(t *testing.T) {
	basePool := teacherDecisionIntegrationPool(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	schema := "teacher_s8_rollback_" + strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")
	quotedSchema := pgx.Identifier{schema}.Sanitize()
	_, err := basePool.Exec(ctx, "CREATE SCHEMA "+quotedSchema)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { _, _ = basePool.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP SCHEMA "+quotedSchema+" CASCADE") })

	conn, err := basePool.Acquire(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer conn.Release()
	_, err = conn.Exec(ctx, "SET search_path TO "+quotedSchema)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	root := migration019RepositoryRoot(t)
	upPaths, err := migrationUpPathsThrough(root, 21)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, path := range upPaths {
		sql, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
		require.NoError(t, readErr, path)
		_, execErr := conn.Exec(ctx, string(sql))
		require.NoError(t, execErr, path)
	}
	down, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db", "migrations", "021_teacher_onboarding_planner_handoff.down.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = conn.Exec(ctx, string(down))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var handoffTablePresent bool
	require.NoError(t, conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff') IS NOT NULL`).Scan(&handoffTablePresent))
	require.False(t, handoffTablePresent)
	var handoffPendingAllowed bool
	require.NoError(t, conn.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%handoff_pending%'
FROM pg_constraint
WHERE connamespace=current_schema()::regnamespace AND conname='teacher_onboarding_interaction_state_check'
`).Scan(&handoffPendingAllowed))
	require.False(t, handoffPendingAllowed)
}

// TestS8HandoffRealPostgresWithFakePlannerAndDialog proves the cross-boundary
// S8 sequence without contacting a live dependency: 021's real ledger owns
// claim/accept/delivery transitions while deterministic Planner and Dialog
// fakes exercise the same worker contracts used in production. It is opt-in
// with the rest of the PostgreSQL suite and never starts a container itself.
func TestS8HandoffRealPostgresWithFakePlannerAndDialog(t *testing.T) {
	basePool := teacherDecisionIntegrationPool(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	schema := "teacher_s8_e2e_" + strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")
	quotedSchema := pgx.Identifier{schema}.Sanitize()
	_, err := basePool.Exec(ctx, "CREATE SCHEMA "+quotedSchema)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { _, _ = basePool.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP SCHEMA "+quotedSchema+" CASCADE") })

	conn, err := basePool.Acquire(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = conn.Exec(ctx, "SET search_path TO "+quotedSchema)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	root := migration019RepositoryRoot(t)
	upPaths, err := migration019UpPaths(root)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, path := range upPaths {
		sql, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
		require.NoError(t, readErr, path)
		_, execErr := conn.Exec(ctx, string(sql))
		require.NoError(t, execErr, path)
	}
	conn.Release()

	config := basePool.Config().Copy()
	if config.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams == nil {
		config.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams = map[string]string{}
	}
	config.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams["search_path"] = schema
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, config)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(pool.Close)

	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	studentID, teacherID, dialogID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO personal_teacher (
 id,student_id,teacher_profile_id,language,communication_style,pedagogy_profile,hint_policy,intervention_mode,created_at,updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,'default','ru','supportive','progressive','progressive','balanced',$3,$3)
`, teacherID, studentID, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	readiness := readyHandoffFixture(domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherFoundationGraphVersion})
	intent, err := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: teacherID, StudentID: studentID}, binding, readiness, "ru", "", "", now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	store := TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository{Pool: pool}
	_, created, err := store.Enqueue(ctx, repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffEnqueue{Intent: intent}, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, created)
	planner := &s8HandoffPlannerHTTP{studentID: studentID, observedAt: "2026-09-11T12:00:00Z", receipts: map[string][]byte{}}
	plannerServer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(planner.serve))
	defer plannerServer.Close()
	plannerClient := learningplannerhttp.Client{BaseURL: plannerServer.URL, HandoffToken: "handoff-token", HTTPClient: plannerServer.Client()}
	dialog := &s8HandoffDialogHTTP{binding: binding, messages: map[string]domain.DialogMessage{}}
	dialogServer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(dialog.serve))
	defer dialogServer.Close()
	worker := onboarding.HandoffWorker{
		Store: store, Planner: plannerClient,
		Readiness: s8HandoffFakeReadiness{}, Responses: dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: dialogServer.URL, InternalToken: "dialog-token", HTTPClient: dialogServer.Client()},
		Proactive: dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: dialogServer.URL, InternalToken: "dialog-token", HTTPClient: dialogServer.Client()},
		IDs:       s8HandoffIDs{}, Clock: s8HandoffClock{now: now}, WorkerID: "s8-e2e-worker", LeaseTTL: time.Minute,
		RetryBaseDelay: time.Second, RetryMaxDelay: time.Minute, MaxAttempts: 3,
	}
	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, planner.calls)
	// Simulate an ambiguous acknowledgement after Planner has persisted the
	// command. The strict adapter must receive an exact 200/replayed=true
	// response for the same stable key and body.
	replayIntent := intent
	replayIntent.Status = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffDispatching
	replayIntent.ClaimToken, replayIntent.LockedBy, replayIntent.LockedUntil = uuid.NewString(), "s8-e2e-replay", now.Add(time.Minute)
	replayIntent.Attempts = 2
	replayIntent, err = domain.NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(replayIntent)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	replay, err := plannerClient.CreateOnboardingPlanHandoff(ctx, replayIntent)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, replay.Replayed)
	require.Equal(t, 2, planner.calls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, planner.receiptCount)
	claimed, err = worker.ProcessNext(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 2, planner.calls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.mutations)
	stored, found, err := store.GetByStudentState(ctx, studentID, readiness.StateRef, *readiness.Goal)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, found)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffDelivered, stored.Status)
	require.NotEmpty(t, stored.PlannerHandoffID)
	require.NotEmpty(t, stored.NotificationMessageID)
	_, err = worker.ProcessNext(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 2, planner.calls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.mutations, "delivered ledger never appends a second proactive Dialog message")
}

type s8HandoffPlannerHTTP struct {
	calls        int
	receiptCount int
	studentID    string
	observedAt   string
	receipts     map[string][]byte
}

func (fake *s8HandoffPlannerHTTP) serve(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	if request.Method != http.MethodPost || request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "handoff-token" || request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") == "" || request.URL.Path != "/internal/students/"+fake.studentID+"/onboarding-plan-handoffs" {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	var payload domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(request.Body)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&payload) != nil || payload.Schema != domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestSchema || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) == nil {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	key := request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
	stored, replayed := fake.receipts[key]
	if replayed && string(stored) != string(encoded) {
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusConflict)
		_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": "idempotency_conflict"}})
		return
	}
	fake.calls++
	if !replayed {
		fake.receipts[key] = encoded
		fake.receiptCount++
	}
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if replayed {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	} else {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	}
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffSchema, HandoffID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffAccepted, StateRef: payload.ExpectedStateRef,
		Goal:            domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherFoundationGraphVersion},
		ExecutionStatus: domain.TeacherOnboardingExecutionNotStarted, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated, ReadinessObservedAt: fake.observedAt, Replayed: replayed})
}

type s8HandoffFakeReadiness struct{}

func (s8HandoffFakeReadiness) ResolveLearningReadiness(context.Context, string, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (domain.TeacherLearningReadiness, error) {
	return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
}

type s8HandoffDialogHTTP struct {
	binding   domain.TeacherDialogBinding
	messages  map[string]domain.DialogMessage
	mutations int
}

func (fake *s8HandoffDialogHTTP) serve(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	if request.Method != http.MethodPost || request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "dialog-token" || request.URL.Path != "/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/"+fake.binding.ID+"/proactive-message" {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	var payload struct {
		PersonalTeacherID string `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
		IdempotencyKey    string `json:"idempotency_key"`
		Body              string `json:"body"`
	}
	if json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload) != nil || payload.PersonalTeacherID != fake.binding.PersonalTeacherID || payload.IdempotencyKey == "" || payload.Body == "" {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	message, replayed := fake.messages[payload.IdempotencyKey]
	if !replayed {
		fake.mutations++
		message = domain.DialogMessage{ID: uuid.NewString(), DialogID: fake.binding.ID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher,
			Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, PersonalTeacherID: fake.binding.PersonalTeacherID, Body: payload.Body, Status: 1, Version: 1,
			MessageSequence: int64(fake.mutations), LastEventSequence: int64(fake.mutations), CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
		fake.messages[payload.IdempotencyKey] = message
	}
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if replayed {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	} else {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	}
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(s5DialogMessageJSON(message))
}

type s8HandoffIDs struct{}

func (s8HandoffIDs) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

type s8HandoffClock struct{ now time.Time }

func (clock s8HandoffClock) Now() time.Time { return clock.now }

func readyHandoffFixture(goal domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal) domain.TeacherLearningReadiness {
	reason := domain.TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved
	if goal.Code == domain.TeacherGoBackendGoalCode {
		reason = domain.TeacherReadinessReasonGoBackendGraphResolved
	}
	return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{
		Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessReady,
		ReasonCodes: []string{reason}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef:       domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4},
		ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated, Goal: &goal,
	}
}
